entries.title: A merge card says when a failed check fails on main too
entries.body: Merge cards identify checks that also fail on main, so you can choose whether to merge or wait for a fix. Other merge cards wait until checks pass. Projects with no checks can still offer their merge card after the crewmate confirms that none are registered.

picture.alt: A merge card whose checks read one failed, with unit-tests marked Fails on main too and a sentence under it saying main's newest run of the check failed as well, so the failure is outside this change.
